ItemDef.Name: aeyn
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Indicate if the subject experienced any adverse events.

ItemDef.Name: aespid
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote:
Record unique identifier for each adverse event for this subject.

Number sequence for all following forms should not duplicate existing numbers for the subject.

ItemDef.Name: aeterm
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Record only one diagnosis, sign or symptom per form (e.g., nausea and vomiting should not be recorded in the same entry, but as two separate entries). See eCRF completion instruction for more information.

Question.TranslatedText: What is the adverse event term?

ItemDef.Name: aestdat
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Record the start date of the adverse event using the MM-DD-YYYY format.

Question.TranslatedText: What is the date the adverse event started?

ItemDef.Name: aesttim
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: If appropriate, record the time the AE started using the HH:MM (24-hour clock) format.

Question.TranslatedText: At what time did the adverse event start?

ItemDef.Name: aeongo
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Select one.

Question.TranslatedText: Is the adverse event still ongoing?

ItemDef.Name: aeendat
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: Record the end date of the adverse event using the MM-DD-YYYY format.

Question.TranslatedText: What date did the adverse event end?

ItemDef.Name: aeentim
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: If appropriate, record the time the AE ended using the HH:MM (24-hour clock) format.

Question.TranslatedText: At what time did the adverse event end?

ItemDef.Name: aesev
ItemDef.redcap:FieldNote: The reporting physician/healthcare professional will assess the severity of the event using the sponsor-defined categories. This assessment is subjective and the reporting physician/ healthcare professional should use medical judgment to compare the reported Adverse Event to similar type events observed in clinical practice. Severity is not equivalent to seriousness.

Question.TranslatedText: What was the severity of the adverse event?
